ms.promise:
This project basically consists of just a few straightforward tasks: translate, dub, edit and publish. Then repeat, repeat and repeat. I've been repeating this same process over and over again since +5 years ago. This is why you will also see that milestones are also repeating themselves..
Original project in ideascale shows 40k words translated/dubbed per month, over an eight month period. As per milestone reviewer convenience, this will be grouped in a total of 4 milestones of 2 months and 80k words in each of them.
・At least 80k words of Cardano content transcripted into Spanish.
・Each transcription is published in the Cardano Forum
・Each transcription is dubbed into Spanish and published on the “Cardano Castellano” Youtube Channel and mirrored in the Odysee platform.
・Provide a straightforward report where in a single page reviewers can take a look at all the information related to the current milestone.
ms.criteria:
・All transcriptions are published in the Cardano Forum where several Hispanic Cardano community members who also speak English can confirm the quality of this output.
・All dubbed and edited videos are published in the Cardano Castellano Youtube Channel and Odysee platform where several Hispanic Cardano community members who also speak English can confirm the quality of this output.
